secrets.name: Carbonate arch
secrets.text: A low arch links two carbonate flanges. The sheltered underside preserves pale layers left by mineral-rich flow.

secrets.name: Old carbonate stump
secrets.text: A broken carbonate spire marks an older fluid pathway. Small ledges record successive periods of growth.

secrets.name: Quiet seep
secrets.text: A pale microbial veil traces slow fluid escape along a crack in the fractured massif.
